final:
-- Index of the chosen slot: always in [0, n), and the same seed gives the same slot.
slot(seed: int, n: int) -> int =
  pre n > 0
  post out >= 0 and out < n
  ex slot(7, 3) == 1
  ex slot(-1, 3) == 2
  seed % n

-- Element picked from a non-empty list by seed. Pure, so it declares no capabilities.
pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  post out == xs[slot(seed, xs.len())]
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
  ex pick([5], -7) == 5
  xs[slot(seed, xs.len())]
